$comment: ANA feature manifest. Each feature lists the skill that ports it, standalone modules to copy as-is, and anchors: strings that exist in the code once the feature is in. skills/ana-update/scripts/ana-diff.mjs searches a target ANA's .js/.html files for these anchors to report present / partial / missing. test.cjs checks that every anchor exists in this repo, so keep them in sync when you rename things.

runtime.note: Shared runtime. Never patch it per ANA. If it differs from upstream, replace the whole file (ask the user first — every ANA on the host shares it).

features.title: Chat window — Claude app layout
features.summary: User bubbles, markdown replies without bubbles, 'Ran 3 commands ›' tool groups, ✳ elapsed-time spinner, floating blurred composer, ↓ jump button with new-message dot, keyboard-fit on iOS.

features.title: Session combo box
features.summary: Full-width, left-aligned agent-session combo in the chat header; popup matches its width; 'You' only on the session this screen views.

features.title: Reliable send state
features.summary: Optimistic bubble → sent → acked (agent started working) → confirmed; handles [Pasted text] echoes so delivered messages never show Unconfirmed/Resend.

features.title: Structured chat log (Claude Code + Codex)
features.summary: Render the chat from the agent's own JSONL log instead of the screen mirror: ~/.claude/projects/<cwd>/*.jsonl for Claude Code, ~/.codex/sessions/**/rollout-*.jsonl for Codex. Real model name in the composer. Opens with the latest 40 items and loads earlier ones 40 at a time as you scroll up (scroll position kept).

features.title: Model & effort picker sheet
features.summary: Tap the model pill → bottom sheet like the Claude app. Claude Code: /model + /effort, result read back from the screen. Codex: model catalog from ~/.codex/models_cache.json, picked through Codex's own menu.

features.title: Permission mode picker (Claude Code + Codex)
features.summary: Model sheet › Permissions shows the agent's current permission mode and switches it. Claude Code: reads the status line and presses Shift+Tab until the wanted mode shows (manual · accept edits · plan · auto · bypass). Codex: /permissions menu (Ask for approval · Approve for me · Full Access) with its extra confirmation. Modes without prompts ask first; A shield icon in the composer shows the mode at a glance (red with "!" when it never asks) and opens a permissions-only sheet.

features.title: Plan usage rings (5-hour · weekly)
features.summary: Two ring charts in the composer that fill as the plan limit is used; tap for % and reset time. Claude: api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the local login. Codex: rate_limits from its rollout log.

features.title: Voice dictation
features.summary: Mic button using the browser's SpeechRecognition; dictates into the input at the cursor. Hidden when unsupported.

features.title: File attachments
features.summary: ＋ button uploads files to .ana/uploads and sends their paths with the message; images show as thumbnails in the bubble.

features.title: Context chips (Chip mode)
features.summary: Chip toggle; tap any on-screen item to attach it to the next message as a context chip; refresh button rescans the page.

features.title: Draw on screen (annotation)
features.summary: Pen button next to refresh; draw red/magenta/blue marks, then 'Add to chat' attaches an annotated screenshot + the items under the marks. Opens the chat right away on mobile.

features.title: Requests (agent → user)
features.summary: Requests tab: everything the agent needs from you in one list — pending data-change diffs plus approval / decision / access requests, work only you can do (action) and missing information (info). Sub-tabs Waiting · In progress · Done. Every card says in plain words what's going on, what is asked, what it changes and what happens if not (why / ask / effect / ifNot). Answer, mark done or dismiss; Ask the agent has it fill the list.

features.title: Evolve (agent → app proposals)
features.summary: Evolve tab (Waiting · In progress · Done): the agent looks at the work (notes, tasks, events, where the flow breaks) and the usage log (/api/activity), and proposes what to do now and how ANA should change — at three horizons (tidy · improve · reimagine), with the reason, what changes for people and what others do (links). Do it hands the proposal to the agent, which updates the PRD when what the app does changed.

features.title: Tabs: PRD · Work · Knowledge · Requests · Evolve · Update
features.summary: One workspace. Six top tabs (a bottom menu on phones), opening on PRD: PRD with Current · History; Work, empty until it is built from the PRD (screens go into #workArea, with sub-tabs if there are several kinds of work); Knowledge with Ontology · Graph; Requests, Evolve and Update, each with Waiting · In progress · Done. Badges count what is waiting.

features.title: PRD (what this ANA is and does)
features.summary: PRD tab, first and where a new ANA opens: what this ANA is and does. A new ANA has no PRD — it is written from the first conversation: the person says (or sketches) what they want, the agent asks what it still needs, then in the same turn saves the PRD (sections of prd-template.md) and builds the first Work screen (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md). Starter examples and Talk to ANA open the chat; Edit lets a person write it; every save is a new version, History keeps earlier ones (viewable, restorable).

features.title: Update tab (check upstream, port with the agent)
features.summary: Update tab (Waiting · In progress · Done): Check for updates fetches agent-native-agent into .ana/upstream and runs ana-diff.mjs against this ANA. Each missing or partial feature, newer module and shared-runtime difference becomes an item. Bring it in sends the agent a porting instruction with the skill, missing anchors and the upstream path; the agent reports done/fail via /api/update-act. Skipped items stay hidden from later checks.

features.title: Knowledge (ontology and graph, filled by the agent)
features.summary: Knowledge tab (Ontology · Graph · Documents): work and knowledge in one view. Ontology shows the work kinds and links declared in work-ontology.js (with counts) and the knowledge kinds and relations; Graph draws work items (squares), things (circles), work links, facts and dashed mentions (All · Work · Knowledge filter). The knowledge starts empty; Ask the agent has it read the work and add to it (POST /api/knowledge, same id = update, same fact = one; a fact may end at a work item). Things outside the ontology are kept and marked new. People remove what is wrong. graph-index.js computes the one graph in memory (no dependency) for /api/graph/trace · neighbors · schema.

features.title: Sketch a screen
features.summary: A blank sketch pad (pen, box, text, eraser; black / red / blue; undo, clear) to draw a rough screen. Double-click writes text in place; texts and boxes (by their edge) can be picked, moved, resized from a corner (or the wheel on text), recolored and deleted. Send to ANA attaches it to the chat as a PNG; the agent builds from it and keeps it in the PRD under Sketches (markdown images from /uploads/ are shown). Opened from the PRD, the start card and the empty Work tab.

features.title: Knowledge › Documents (files the agent reads)
features.summary: Knowledge › Documents: people add files (specs, price lists, manuals — up to 25 MB each, button or drag and drop). They are kept in .ana/documents; GET /api/documents lists them with the path the agent reads. Knowledge's Ask the agent reads them, and facts and things can cite a document (items: doc-N), shown as a Doc chip that opens the file. Images, PDF and text open in the browser; everything else (HTML, SVG…) is always a download.
